versions.name: Nobscot Scout Reservation
versions.summary: A 452-acre Mayflower Council reservation on Nobscot Hill in Framingham and Sudbury, Massachusetts, west of Boston, offering year-round weekend camping and an outdoor-education program. It no longer runs a summer camp.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the community scout-camp-map project. The source mis-attributed it to Spirit of Adventure Council; it is a Mayflower Council reservation, verified against the council's camp page. Its summer camp no longer runs (weekend camping + outdoor education only). Coordinates geocoded from the address (approximate — a 452-acre property); elevation from the open-meteo DEM. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add with corrected council (Mayflower, not Spirit of Adventure). Existence, council, and no-summer-camp status verified against the council page; features unsurveyed.
